semantics: EXCLUDE dict: a way is DROPPED if it carries any of the listed values for that key. Everything else is included by default.
directedness: DIRECTED -- respects the generic `oneway` tag (standard default). oneway:bicycle contraflow exceptions ARE present in the source data (verified) but are NOT yet applied to override directionality in this baseline -- a documented limitation, not a silent gap.
notes: highway values always excluded regardless of mode: abandoned/construction/no/planned/platform/proposed/raceway/razed/rest_area/services.
access=private and service=private ways excluded; bicycle=no ways excluded explicitly.
Unlike walking, sidewalk-mapped-separately is not a cycling-relevant exclusion (cycleways are handled by the highway=cycleway inclusion, not a sidewalk tag).
